neglected_tropical_diseases.description: WHO NTD list: diseases of poverty affecting 1.7 billion people
neglected_tropical_diseases.what_we_offer: GPU-accelerated microscopy classification (toadStool + coralReef), sovereign edge deployment (no cloud needed)

malaria.description: Kills 600,000+ per year. Mostly children under 5 in sub-Saharan Africa.
malaria.what_we_offer: barracuda GPU genomics pipeline, DADA2-equivalent for Plasmodium sequencing

tuberculosis.description: Kills 1.3 million per year. Drug-resistant TB is a global emergency.
tuberculosis.what_we_offer: GPU-accelerated whole genome sequencing pipeline, sovereign analysis (no cloud = data stays in-country)

antimicrobial_resistance.description: AMR kills 1.27 million per year. The silent pandemic.
antimicrobial_resistance.what_we_offer: barracuda GPU genomics, sovereign computing (data sovereignty critical for AMR surveillance)

dengue_arbovirus.description: 3.9 billion at risk. No specific treatment. Climate change expanding range.
dengue_arbovirus.what_we_offer: GPU-accelerated time series forecasting, sovereign edge deployment for real-time surveillance

cholera_diarrheal.description: Cholera kills up to 143,000 per year. Diarrheal diseases kill 1.6 million.
cholera_diarrheal.what_we_offer: GPU SEIR modeling, real-time climate data integration, sovereign edge surveillance

maternal_neonatal.description: 295,000 maternal deaths per year. 2.4 million neonatal deaths. Mostly preventable.
maternal_neonatal.what_we_offer: Portable GPU inference for fetal monitoring, offline-first sovereign deployment

soil_transmitted_helminths.description: 1.5 billion infected worldwide. Worm infections of poverty.
soil_transmitted_helminths.what_we_offer: GPU image classification (no CUDA), portable edge deployment on cheap hardware

wastewater_surveillance.description: Early warning for pandemics. Detects pathogens before clinical cases appear.
wastewater_surveillance.what_we_offer: Rust-native wastewater genomics, GPU acceleration, sovereign real-time surveillance

rust_bioinformatics.description: Our DIRECT kin. Rust tools for biological science.
rust_bioinformatics.what_we_offer: We ARE Rust bioinformatics. 87 repos, 3.6M lines, GPU-first.

african_open_science.description: Open science initiatives from/for the Global South.
african_open_science.what_we_offer: Sovereign computing: science on YOUR hardware, not rented cloud. AGPL ensures the code stays free.

chagas_leishmania.description: Chagas: 6-7 million infected. Leishmaniasis: 1 million new cases/year.
chagas_leishmania.what_we_offer: GPU-accelerated genomics, sovereign data processing (keeps genomic data in-country)

human_cost.note: These are PREVENTABLE deaths. The tools exist. The code is open. The GPU is ready.
human_cost.what_one_star_does: Sends a notification to a lonely researcher. They check our profile. They find 87 repos of sovereign science tools. They clone one. They run it on their local GPU. They publish. The cycle continues.

backscatter_chain.step_2: They visit ecoPrimal profile → see 87 repos
backscatter_chain.step_3: They find barracuda/toadStool/coralReef → GPU tools for their disease
backscatter_chain.step_4: They cargo add our crates → sovereign science on their hardware
backscatter_chain.step_5: They publish with our tools → cite ecoPrimals
backscatter_chain.step_6: sunCloud flywheel: their citation → more visibility → more researchers find us
